beta_qe_axial_v1.label: beta-PVDF, Dipole QE 7.6 PBE-D3(BJ): six +/-1% axial strain cells from pvdf_beta_ref_v1 (exchange main 54897c21, 2026-11-05)
beta_qe_axial_v1.note: Ions relaxed at each fixed strained cell (forces <= 2.7e-5 Ry/bohr), SCF 1e-11 Ry, same SSSP 90/360 Ry and 8x4x16 mesh as the reference. Stiffness derived here by polyfind from Dipole's stresses: C_ij = -d sigma_i / d eta_j across the +/-1% pair (QE's stress carries the pressure sign), symmetrised (reciprocity mismatch 0.25 GPa); the energy route, (dE+ + dE-) = C V0 eta^2, gives the diagonal within 1.5%. Relaxed-ion, other strains clamped: the normal block of C. The -1% cells cost 0.3 meV (0.6 along the chain) more than the +1% cells: third-order stiffening in compression. quantitatively_valid is false on every unit in Dipole's scope (one local equilibrium and its strain neighbours; acceptance as a quantitative reference is theirs to declare).

beta_qe_berry_v1.label: beta-PVDF, Dipole QE 7.6 PBE-D3(BJ) Berry-phase polarization at the pvdf_beta_ref_v1 cell (beta_zero_berry_repeat_v1, exchange main 2026-11-06)
beta_qe_berry_v1.note: Three independent occupied-only NSCF Berry repeats per lattice direction from one common SCF checkpoint (24 occupied bands, 8x4x16 mesh, indirect gap 0.2206 Eh); the three vectors agree to 3e-10 C/m^2. Dipole's scope: repeat evidence only, not strain-path branch tracking or E1 acceptance; quantitatively_valid false. The polarization quantum along a is e a / V = 0.728 C/m^2, so 0.193 is the branch nearest zero. This is the polarization of the same Hamiltonian and cell as the other anchors, and it replaces the published 0.18 (other functionals and cells) as the crystal fit's P anchor from stage 5 on (stages 1-4 used 0.18).
